lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: How was the exam, Richard?
lines.zh: 考试考得怎么样，理查德？

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: Not too bad.
lines.zh: 不算太坏。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
lines.zh: 我想我的英语和数学及格了。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: The questions were very easy.
lines.zh: 题目很容易。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: How about you, Gary?
lines.zh: 加里，你怎么样？

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me.
lines.zh: 英语和数学试题对我来说不很容易。

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: I hope I haven't failed.
lines.zh: 我希望别不及格。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: I think I failed the French paper.
lines.zh: 我想我的法语及不了格。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: I could answer sixteen of the questions.
lines.zh: 我能回答其中的16道题。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: They were very easy.
lines.zh: 这些题很容易。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: But I couldn't answer the rest.
lines.zh: 但我回答不出其余的题。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: They were too difficult for me.
lines.zh: 那些题对我来说太难了。

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: French tests are awful, aren't they?
lines.zh: 法语考试太可怕了，你说呢？

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: I hate them.
lines.zh: 我讨厌法语考试。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: I'm sure I've got a low mark.
lines.zh: 我的法语成绩肯定很低。

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: Oh, cheer up!
lines.zh: 啊，别灰心！

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
lines.zh: 或许我们考得还不太糟。

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
lines.zh: 坐在我旁边的那个人只在试卷顶端写了自己的名字。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.en: Yes?
lines.zh: 是吗？

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!
lines.zh: 然后他就坐在那里，对着考卷看了3个小时，

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.en: He didn't write a word!
lines.zh: 一个字也没写！

drills.en: I think I ___ in English and Mathematics.
drills.zh: 我想我的英语和数学及格了。

drills.en: I couldn't speak to the boss. He was ___ busy.
drills.zh: 我没能和老板说话。他太忙了。

drills.en: I couldn't go out. It was ___ cold for me to go out.
drills.zh: 我没能出去。天气太冷，我出不去。

drills.en: I could answer all the questions. They were ___ easy.
drills.zh: 我能回答所有的题。这些题非常容易。

drills.en: Is that suitcase light ___ for you to carry?
drills.zh: 那个手提箱对你来说够轻吗？

drills.en: Is your brother old ___ to be a member of our association?
drills.zh: 你哥哥够大了，能当我们协会的会员吗？

drills.en: They couldn't see that film. They were ___ young.
drills.zh: 他们没能看那部电影。他们太小了。

drills.en: Could he buy the car? Yes, it was cheap ___ for him to buy.
drills.zh: 他买得起这辆车吗？能，这辆车对他来说够便宜。

drills.en: Could they eat the cakes? No, they were ___ stale.
drills.zh: 他们能吃那些蛋糕吗？不能，蛋糕太不新鲜了。
